q: What was the relationship between Paul and Timothy?
a: Timothy was Paul’s true son in the faith.

q: What overflowed to Paul, resulting in Paul becoming an apostle of Jesus Christ?
a: The grace of our Lord overflowed with faith and love to Paul.

q: What does God desire for all people?
a: God desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

q: In what does Paul want women to remain?
a: Paul wants women to continue in faith and love and sanctification with self-control.

q: What is the danger if the overseer is a new convert?
a: The danger is that he will be puffed up and fall into condemnation.

q: What lies will these people teach?
a: They will forbid marriage and forbid eating some foods.

q: How is anything we eat sanctified for our use?
a: Anything we eat is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

q: In what ways is Timothy to be an example to others?
a: Timothy is to be an example in word, conduct, love, faith, and purity.

q: How did Timothy receive the spiritual gift that he had?
a: The gift was given to Timothy through prophecy, with the imposition of the hands of the elders.

q: What conditions must be met before someone accuses an elder?
a: There must be two or three witnesses when someone accuses an elder.

q: What fight does Paul say Timothy must fight?
a: Paul says Timothy must fight the good fight of the faith.
